events.title: Grounded spec built
events.reasoning: I searched Procol's own code, config map, endpoint list and PRD for: "Convert an approved PR into an event". Top evidence came from: prd-procol-sourcing.md, catalog.json, product-questionnaire.md, console-config-map.md. The product supports creating multi-stage sourcing events (RFP/RFQ/auction), inviting vendors, and awarding, plus team-based user management. I found one spec-vs-product gap worth testing: the phone field — the PRD says accept any 10-digit number, but the backend only validates length, not digit-type.

deltas.prdSays: Accept any 10-digit number; reject malformed input politely (PRD §4.3, §5).
deltas.productDoes: The API checks phone LENGTH (rejects 9 or 11 digits) but NOT that characters are digits — it accepts a 10-char value containing letters. The frontend enforces digits-only, so the API is more lenient than the UI.

Because they are all active, I will prioritize execution on these enabled flows. This ensures we follow the client’s current setup without unnecessary filtering.
